explanation: With dt=1/30 and G=5 and several ~1.4-separated masses including two 20-mass bodies, accelerations are large. The leapfrog with only 6 substeps cannot resolve the close approach of bodies 3-4 (0.66 apart at step 2): kinetic energy grows faster than potential deepens, so total energy jumps ~131 vs allowed ~107. Lowering G alone removes the violation, confirming an integration-accuracy failure under strong gravity at large dt.
